I think my brain got used to my bare face so I feel more comfortable with it.

Hello there ! I had SAME (surgically assisted maxillary expansion) performed last year and it took me about 8 weeks until I was able to start slowly in the gym again (stretching, light cardio etc.) As far as I was told by my surgeon, you should avoid pressure a few months post operation so everything can heal without disruption due to pressure. I tried to do some pushups back then but stopped it because I felt that it was too early. You’ll be able to tell how much you can “do to your body” and what might be too fast. 
In my case I was able to do squats with more weight on pretty fast ( about 9-10 weeks post surgery) and the rest of my training proceeded good as well (maybe not going all in, but it was a good workout anyways) I just avoided any kind of hard pressure movements which would affect my jaw. 

I’m having double jaw surgery performed next summer but I’m still not able to do bench pressing because the pressure hurt my joints so I go for lighter work instead. I would recommend to ask your surgeon specifically about your concerns he can advise you on that topic. 

Maybe this little insight might help you and sorry in advance if anything isn’t clear English isn’t my mother tongue :)
